create.title: Create order
create.subtitle: Choose the pharmacy, build the medicine cart, and submit a recoverable order draft.

draft.restoredDescription: The pharmacy, notes, medicines, and quantities were recovered from this device.

details.warehouseHint: This order will be fulfilled from the only available warehouse.

alternatives.subtitle: Available substitutes related to {{medicine}}.

cart.priceHint: Offers, gifts, and the final discount are calculated by the server when the order is created.
